description: Land Title Settlement Department - Galgediyawa, Udapalatha D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320148 (23/55044)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land and property matters, specifically notices calling for claims to intestate property under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed land descriptions including village names, cadastral map numbers, parcel numbers, land extents, and certificate of title numbers. The content focuses on land title registration and property claims, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it involves land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
